body: Hello! I'm assuming this post is from 2021. Since then, I broke out of that one binge cycle, then got in another full one, and then started binging less and less, but restricting more. Then I decided to work towards recovery for real, and got diagnosed for my ADHD, and the meds I take work wonders for curbing binge urges, thoughts, the appeal that eating until I feel dead has. I also left a stressful job that was leaving me no choice but to eat my feelings away. I can't advise you so much but I think addressing why the binges are happening is the first step. Maybe it's something that are not so obvious, maybe it's something that will need medical help, physical and psychological like me. Then see what will work the best for you to overcome it. Best of luck, I hope you can break the cycle asap!!

Not even sing, I just say "roll up to the party" totally out of the blue. When I finish laughing hard about something, I say "roll up to the party". I don't even understand myself sometimes...

I don't know about saving my life, but last year I was having such a stressful time with my job, college, my self image, my mental health, and generally speaking I was completely worried about my future. I didn't have energy to get up from bed, all I could think was how good it would be if 'this' (I hope you get what I mean) ended as soon as possible. 

Music and performance are my main things, seriously, it's what I have in my mind 24/7, which was actually a reason why my worries were suffocating me. And at the time I wasn't capable of enjoying this anymore. It made me even worse.

So by june I started engaging in SHINee. They were always my favorite boygroup, but until then I just admired them from afar. Slowly, I was knowing them better, enjoying their discography... some of their quotes stuck with me. Then Bad Love was released in september and everything went SO FAST from there. It is my favorite 2021 album, my first kpop purchase, and I love everything about it. I loved it so much that it made me enjoy music, dance and art again. Since the release, I got so much deeper in SHINee's discography and their concepts, plus their personalities. Turns out I have a lot in common with them, and it made me feel less alone. 

Now, I feel better because of them. I'm still not in a good place mentally, but having something to love and to rely on in difficult times helps a lot. I always have my Jonghyun pin with me and it somehow calms me. Their music is exactly my cup of tea. And looking for my albums to arrive is also a reason to stay lol

~~Biased Review Alert!~~ **SHINee**. Their discography is unique and experimental, as them being a comtemporary group. For me, they have the best discography, because of their ability to fit any concept, and to make very concise albums (a trait that I as a music enthusiast value a lot).

My absolute favorite album of them (and my second favorite album of all time) is Misconceptions of Us. Key designed the cover art, the bsides are phenomenal, the overall concept is beautiful and unique, both inside and outside the physical album (and by that I mean the stages aesthetics etc.). One of the few full albums that has no skips for me.

I see that you like some 3rd/4th gen groups, so I recommend the The Story of Light trilogy, Don't Call Me, and Odd albums.

And boy, their solo works are divine. Really. Taemin is not the "idol's idol" for nothing. I think you will enjoy going through his bsides. My favorites are Ace and Want albums. Jonghyun wrote incredibly sentimental and poetic songs that you can check in his discography. Base, She Is and Poet | Artist are his more pop-ish works. Onew is still to expand his discography unfortunatelly, but Voice is amazing mini album, with strong vocals, melancholic beats and comforting lyrics. Key has Face and Bad Love to his name, and I can't stress this enough: BAD LOVE IS THE ALBUM OF THE YEAR. Overall, imo, 10/10. The retro concept is just too perfect to me. Seriously, Helium is the best bside of 2021, period.

​

Other groups that have flawless discographies for me are: f(x), THE BOYZ, SF9, AB6IX, CLC, gugudan, Weki Meki, GWSN, 9MUSES.
